---
title: ZéBolão 2026
format: html
---

```{r}
#| include: false

dia_atual <- 1

library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)

plans <- readxl::excel_sheets("planilha_mestra_26.xlsx")

apostas <- setdiff(plans, c("APOSTAS", "RESULTADOS"))

ponts <- lapply(
  apostas,
  function(plan) {
    readxl::read_xlsx(
      "planilha_mestra_26.xlsx",
      sheet = plan,
      range = readxl::cell_cols(c("H", "U")),
      .name_repair = "unique_quiet"
    ) |>
      select(1, 2, 14) |>
      rename(data = DATA, hora = `...2`, pont = `...14`) |>
      filter(!is.na(data) & data != "DIA") |>
      mutate(
        data = as.Date(as.integer(data), origin = "1899-12-30"),
        hora = as.numeric(hora) * 24,
        dia = as.integer(data - as.Date("2026-06-11") + 1)
      ) |>
      mutate(dia = ifelse(hora < 2, dia - 1L, dia))
  }
)
names(ponts) <- apostas
```

## Pontuação por dia

```{r}
#| echo: false

acums <- lapply(
  ponts,
  function(pont) {
    bind_rows(
      pont,
      tibble::tibble(data = as.Date("2026-06-10"), hora = 0, pont = 0, dia = 0)
    ) |>
      summarize(pont = sum(pont), .by = dia) |>
      arrange(dia) |>
      mutate(pontacum = cumsum(pont)) |>
      filter(dia <= dia_atual)
  }
)
acums <- bind_rows(acums, .id = "nome")

p <- ggplot(acums) +
  geom_line(aes(dia, pontacum, color = nome)) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom")

plotly::ggplotly(p)
```

## Pontuação do dia `r dia_atual`

```{r}
#| echo: false

onts <- lapply(
  ponts,
  function(pont) {
    summarize(pont, pont = sum(pont), .by = dia) |>
      filter(dia == 1)
  }
)
onts <- bind_rows(onts, .id = "nome")

if (nrow(onts) == 0) {
  cat("Não houve jogo ontem.")
} else {
  p <- ggplot(onts) +
    geom_col(aes(nome, pont)) +
    theme_minimal()

  plotly::ggplotly(p)
}
```
